{{Quote|I don't care who those guys are. Kick them out; last time they were here they roughed up some of my regulars.|translated=1|Chalmun|<ref name="gg7" />}}
'''Chalmun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] proprietor of the most popular spacer's bar in [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], the eponymous [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Chalmun's cantina]]. A distant relative of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]], he was a large tan-and-gray Wookiee, with a scar running from his left shoulder across the left side of his chest. This was a remnant of his days as a street thug.

==Biography==
===The Cantina===
[[File:Wretched_Hive.png|thumb|left|175px|Chalmun manning the bar]]
Chalmun was a beige and gray-colored [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] born on [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] in [[157 BBY/Legends|157 BBY]],<ref name="gg7" /> and a distant relative of [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]],<ref name="rd">''[[Rebel Dawn]]''</ref> a famous Wookiee who became a member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="anh">{{Film|IV}}</ref> Chalmun grew up as a street thug, quickly learning that his natural stature and weight as a Wookiee gave him a distinct advantage in brawls; however, he also learned first-hand that strength meant little when one was faced with a blaster.<ref name="gg7" />

At some point in his life, Chalmun was badly scarred, with a diagonal scar running from his left shoulder across the left side of his chest.<ref name="gg7" /> Chalmun was a street fighter for a long time before he ran up a huge profit [[Con artist/Legends|swindling]] hapless tourists at the [[Casino/Legends|casinos]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in just a few years. He used the funds to purchase a popular [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]]&mdash;known simply as the [[Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina/Legends|Mos Eisley cantina]]&mdash;from two [[Ranat/Legends|Ranats]], the [[Vriichon brothers/Legends|Vriichon brothers]], located in the heart of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], largest city on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="cl">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref>

The Vriichons left Tatooine post haste after the sale&mdash;they had been using the cantina as a front for an illegal [[Spice/Legends|spice]] den, and were afraid that the Wookiee would be angry with them when he discovered the numerous bodies they had buried in the building's base. The cantina, which quickly became known as "Chalmun's Cantina"<ref name="cl" /> or simply "Chalmun's,"<ref name="rd" /> was extremely popular with [[Smuggler/Legends|smugglers]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] and various other shady individuals, because of its central location, wide variety of beverages, and loose rules:<ref name="gg7" /> while fighting was banned and rowdy individuals sometimes ejected,<ref name="hs">''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]''</ref> the rules were rarely enforced, so muggings and shootings were commonplace.<ref name="cl" />

Chalmun became loyal to his regulars, and any who treated them poorly were swiftly kicked out. He also abhorred droids, refusing them entry in his cantina.<ref name="gg7" /> Chalmun rarely worked personally in the bar, instead employing bartenders such as [[Wuher/Legends|Wuher]] and [[Ackmena/Legends|Ackmena]] to serve drinks; he spent most of his time in his office, which contained his own personal bar, tended by [[Nimbanel/Legends|Nimbanel]] barman [[Husklf/Legends|Husklf]]. Chalmun also employed security for the cantina, who used a complex listening system to eavesdrop on conversations,<ref name="cl" /> and a bouncer named [[Tork]].<ref name="hs" /> Other employees included [[Lurval]] and the [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] [[Muna Skish]].<ref name="SWG:C">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Trader|Crafting|Tatooine}}</ref> The Wookiee also kept a personal pilot and escape ship, ready to flee the cantina should the need arise.<ref name="cl" />

===Later life===
[[File:ChalmunWorking-SWT.png|thumb|right|200px|Chalmun working at the bar]]

Since coming to own the cantina, he had distanced himself from the kinds of situations that had provoked the violence he so enjoyed in his youth. However, he often provided his hospitality to beings associated with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] and retired celebrity [[Podracer (profession)/Legends|podracers]].

Despite this, Chalmun was rarely seen in the main cantina; instead spending the majority of the time in his back office. Many who saw the Wookiee there mistook him for a bouncer, owing both to his formidable appearance and his tendency to physically remove anyone who caused trouble. Of course, owing to his history, he also admired people who caused trouble ''with style'', which also meant that making friends with him was a tightrope walk.

Chalmun remained the owner of the cantina when it was visited by [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], and Chewbacca shortly before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

After the Battle of Yavin, Chalmun allowed [[Talon Karrde]] and [[Dravis]] to use the the back rooms of cantina to supervise the operations of the [[Smugglers' Alliance|Smuggler Alliance]].<ref name="SWG:SA">{{SWGcite|exp=JtL|type=other|Smuggler Alliance}}</ref>

In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Gendra]] recruited several [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]], including a [[Merchant/Legends|trader]] and an [[entertainer]], to help his friend Chalmun who was facing several problems at the cantina. The trader crafted new glassware and was eager to prepare [[Jerky/Legends|meat jerky]] and [[Spice tea/Legends|spiced tea]] for the customers of the cantina. The entertainer agreed with performing in the cantina, dancing and [[Musician/Legends|playing music]] for the patrons who where delighted by the shows.<ref name="SWG:C" /><ref name="SWG:E">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Entertainer|Entertainment|Tatooine}}</ref>
